It requires architectural decisions that will impact the entire project and involves multiple technical components that need to be properly integrated.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the authentication system implementation into specific subtasks covering user registration flow, login functionality, JWT token management, role-based access control middleware, password reset functionality, and frontend authentication components.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Authentication is a critical security component with multiple interconnected parts. It involves both frontend and backend work, security considerations, and several user flows (registration, login, password reset). The role-based access control adds additional complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the vendor profile management into subtasks covering database model design, API endpoint implementation, image upload functionality, frontend form components with validation, and vendor dashboard implementation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves creating a complete feature with both frontend and backend components. The image upload functionality adds complexity, and the vendor dashboard requires careful UX consideration. However, it's more focused than the previous tasks.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the product management implementation into subtasks covering product database schema design, API endpoints for CRUD operations, inventory tracking functionality, product image management, frontend form components, and product listing views.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Product management is a core marketplace feature with significant complexity. It involves database relationships, image handling, inventory tracking, and multiple frontend views. The product data model likely has many attributes and relationships to manage.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the product browsing and search functionality into subtasks covering search algorithm implementation, filter functionality, product listing API endpoints, frontend search interface, and responsive product detail views.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves search functionality which can be complex to implement efficiently. It also requires filter capabilities and responsive design considerations. However, it builds upon the existing product data models, making some aspects more straightforward.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the shopping cart and checkout implementation into subtasks covering cart data model design, cart management API, multi-vendor order processing, payment gateway integration, frontend cart components, checkout flow implementation, and order confirmation system.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This is one of the most complex tasks as it involves payment processing, multi-vendor considerations, and critical business logic. The checkout process must handle various edge cases, payment failures, and ensure data consistency across multiple vendors' products.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the order management system into subtasks covering order data model design, order status workflow implementation, vendor order dashboard, customer order history interface, sales reporting functionality, and order notification system.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Order management involves complex state transitions and needs to serve both vendors and customers with different views and capabilities. It requires reporting functionality and notification integration, adding to its complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the market day management into subtasks covering scheduling data model design, market day CRUD API implementation, vendor notification system, inventory requirement functionality, frontend calendar interface, and admin scheduling tools.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This task involves scheduling logic, inventory requirements, and notification systems. It needs to coordinate between vendors and admins, with dependencies on inventory management. The scheduling component adds significant complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the admin dashboard development into subtasks covering vendor approval workflow, marketplace configuration tools, reporting and analytics implementation, vendor monitoring system, administrative notification center, and dashboard UI implementation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: The admin dashboard touches nearly every part of the system and requires privileged access controls. It involves reporting, monitoring, and management capabilities across multiple domains. The breadth of functionality makes this a complex task.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the notification system implementation into subtasks covering email service integration, in-app notification infrastructure, notification template system, user preference management, and scheduled notification functionality.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: While notifications span the entire application, the core notification infrastructure is relatively focused. The complexity comes from supporting multiple notification channels (email, in-app) and handling various notification triggers and templates.
